items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I asked old Sam Beer for a raise and he said, I'm not only going to give you a raise, I'm going to take you on a vacation with me.

ctx.x: Yes. Roy came in after that. Because Marge told me, why don't you ask Sam Beer for a raise? And so I finally got up the nerve to do it. Because I told her, I said, all the guys are working just like I am and everything like that. I said, it's alright. But she said, no, ask him for a raise. So I did. I asked old Sam Beer for a raise and he said, I'm not only going to give you a raise, I'm going to take you on a vacation with me. (LAUGHTER).
What was his second name, Zutty?
